variants.label: Accept the PO figure
variants.body:
Hi Dana,

You're right, the PO is the figure to go by. I'll get a revised invoice for 12 licences over to you today and the 30 days can run from that one.

Best,
Sam

variants.label: Confirm the licence count first
variants.body:
Hi Dana,

Before I reissue: we billed 14 because two seats were added on [date]. Can you check whether those were meant to sit outside NW-2291? If they were, I'll send a revised invoice for 12 and a separate one for the extras.

Best,
Sam

variants.label: Hold the invoice and escalate internally
variants.body:
Hi Dana,

Let's put invoice 4471 on hold while I take this back to our side — I'd rather sort the licence count properly than reissue twice. I'll come back to you by [date].

Best,
Sam
